masterPrompt: Ultra-minimal 3D icon for Korean math app "우열". Exactly ONE chunky object centered on canvas (~70% size). Soft matte clay, smooth surfaces, big rounded shapes, toy-like simplicity. Use at most 2 flat brand colors plus white. Bold silhouette readable at 48px. Transparent background. NO second object, NO scene, NO props, NO text, NO faces, NO sparkles, NO particles, NO badges, NO stacks, NO orbit rings, NO tiny details, NO ground shadow plate. Negative: busy illustration, realistic render, emoji, flat 2D vector, neon, dark background, watermark, confetti.
